title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years in US prison over Trump murder plot
summary_full: Asif Merchant, allegedly linked to Iran, found by court to have sought retribution over Qassem Suleimani deathA Pakistani man was sentenced to more than 27 years in prison on Tuesday for plotting to assassinate Donald Trump in retaliation for the US killing of Revolutionary Guards commander Qassem Suleimani, the Department of Justice said.Asif Merchant, who had alleged ties to Iran, sought to hire a hitman to assassinate a politician or a government official in the United States, a Brooklyn court found.
